// permission: Baseline ONLY. Every value here is 'allow' or 'deny' and never 'ask': an unattended loop
cannot answer a prompt, so an 'ask' is a run that hangs until its timeout.
Web access is deliberately NOT set here. It is a PER-LOOP capability -- forage needs it,
research and leap must not have it -- and a global 'deny' here resolved onto the forage agent
and would have silently broken the only loop that needs the web.

failure is a wasted cycle. It gets the best model available.
